title: Team & roles
description: Invite your team and decide who can see and change what.

members.title: Members
members.full: All seats of your plan are taken. Remove a member, revoke an invitation or change your plan.
members.removeDescription: They lose access to this restaurant immediately. Their account stays.
members.leaveDescription: You lose access to this restaurant immediately.

invite.title: Invite a team member
invite.description: We send an invitation by email. The link is valid for 7 days.
invite.alreadyMember: This person is already on the team.
invite.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
invite.emailFailed: The email could not be sent. Just share the link yourself, e.g. via WhatsApp.
invite.linkHint: For security reasons we only show the link now. You can create a new one at any time.

invites.title: Open invitations
invites.revokeDescription: The invitation link will stop working.

roles.deleteDescription: The role will be deleted permanently.
roles.deleteWithInvites: {count, plural, one {One open invitation with this role will also be deleted.} other {# open invitations with this role will also be deleted.}}
roles.inUse: Role is still assigned to members
roles.locked: Custom roles and adjusted permissions are part of the Pro plan. You can always assign the default roles.
roles.ownerLocked: The owner role always has all rights and cannot be changed.
roles.matrixHint: Choose what people with this role are allowed to do.

mail.subject: Invitation to {restaurant} on VeroMenu
mail.body:
Hello,

{inviter} invited you to {restaurant} on VeroMenu as “{role}”.

Accept the invitation:
{link}

The link is valid for {days} days. If you did not expect this invitation, you can ignore this email.
